RuntimeService（C#）

Service introduction

RuntimeService is a service for the inference engine (Runtime) phase* in Atom SDK. Different from the editor stage (GraphService / NodeService), the graph in the Runtime stage has been compiled and optimized, and no node-by-node editing is required - the caller directly submits ordinary frame data (image + point cloud) or passive binocular EPICRAW3 data to the graph, and can also set shared parameters and obtain binding output results. The service also supports running a single node (no graph building required), which is suitable for fast inference and batch processing scenarios. All methods are asynchronous.

namespace: AtomSdk.Services

Entrance: client.Runtime

Applicable scenarios

  • Load the graph configured in the editor stage into the Runtime environment and run it;

  • Submit ordinary camera data (image + point cloud + camera internal and external parameters) or passive binocular EPICRAW3 data to the graph for inference;

  • Read inference results by binding name (JSON value or point cloud binary);

  • Dynamically adjust shared parameters (SetSharedParamsAsync) or operating parameters (SetRunParamsAsync);

  • Run a single node directly without building a graph, and give priority to RunSingleNodeNoGraphParsedAsync that automatically parses the output;

  • Obtain node parameter policy information and finely control reasoning behavior in the Runtime stage.

Recommended calling order

LoadGraphAsync(graphName)          (Load image to Runtime)
        ↓
GetMetaInfoAsync(graphName)        (Optional:Obtain the element information to confirm that the loading is successful)
        ↓
SetSharedParamsAsync(...)          (Optional:Set shared parameters)
SetRunParamsAsync(...)             (Optional:Set operating parameters)
        ↓
RunGraphAsync(RuntimeRunParams)    (Submit input data and run)
        ↓
GetBindedOutputValueAsync(...)     (read JSON output)
GetBindedPointCloudParsedAsync(...)(Recommended:Read and parse point cloud output)
GetBindedPointCloudAsync(...)      (Optional:Read point cloud binary output)
        ↓
ReleaseGraphAsync(graphName)       (release Runtime Graphic resources)

run_graph Two input modes

RunGraphAsync selects the input structure based on RuntimeRunParams:

mode Construction method Input content

Normal mode

new RuntimeRunParams(graphName, frames)

One or more RuntimeFrame, each frame contains the complete EPICRAW + Cam2Base

Passive binocular mode

Recommended RuntimeRunParams.PassiveBinoFromFile/Bytes/Images(…​)

a RuntimePassiveBinoFrame, containing the complete EPICRAW3 + Cam2Base

Do not mix the two modes. Normal mode can encapsulate EPICRAW2 or standard layout EPICRAW3; passive binocular mode must use RuntimePassiveBinoFrame.

Normal mode: RuntimeFrame model

In normal mode, RunGraphAsync accepts IReadOnlyList<RuntimeFrame>. When EPICRAW bytes or files already exist:

using AtomSdk.Models;

var bytesFrame = RuntimeFrame.FromBytes(epicRawBytes, cam2BaseJson, roi);
var fileFrame = RuntimeFrame.FromFile("frame.epicraw", cam2BaseJson, roi);

Generate from original array:

var points = new RuntimePointData(pointValues, width, height);
var image = new RuntimeImageData(imageBytes, width, height);
var frame = RuntimeFrame.FromData(points, image, cam2BaseJson, intrinsic, distortion);

When the version is not specified, ordinary internal parameters/distortions generate EPICRAW2; when cameraParams contains TextureSrc, DepthSrc1 or DepthSrc2, EPICRAW3 is generated. The standard EPICRAW3 only writes Depth + TextureBGR, not the full PointCloud.

Passive binocular mode: RuntimePassiveBinoFrame

If the EpicProInput node in the diagram is configured as passive_bino, please submit a complete copy of the EPICRAW3 original bytes. The server will parse three images, internal parameters, distortion and passive_bino_params from EPICRAW3.

var result = await client.Runtime.RunGraphAsync(
    RuntimeRunParams.PassiveBinoFromFile(
        "detection_graph",
        "/data/passive_bino.epicraw",
        cam2BaseJson));

If the business layer has obtained EPICRAW3 bytes, RuntimeRunParams.PassiveBinoFromBytes(…​) can be used. If the business layer gets three original pictures, it can use RuntimeRunParams.PassiveBinoFromImages(…​), and the picture is represented by new RuntimePassiveBinoImage(data, width, height, matType); matType is OpenCV Mat type encoding, such as CV_8UC1=0, CV_16UC1=2, CV_8UC3=16. passiveBinoParams of PassiveBinoFromImages(…​) needs to contain DepthSrc1, DepthSrc2, TextureSrc and metadata, each of which must contain the following four fields:

var cameraParams = new Dictionary<string, object?>
{
    ["CameraMatrix"] = new[]
    {
        2113.997971632298, 0, 1956.222038925553,
        0, 2113.7299751270057, 1505.0473199581195,
        0, 0, 1,
    },
    ["CameraDistortion"] = new[]
    {
        0.049901632334, -0.037810281265, -0.00048319461,
        -0.000276258172, -0.026886293015,
    },
    ["CameraRotation"] = new[]
    {
        0.9995132330503337, -0.005059159488191983, -0.030784766728731865,
        0.004951704878090689, 0.9999813828533568, -0.003565748937897527,
        0.030802233296787017, 0.003411576169582241, 0.999519676430619,
    },
    ["CameraTranslation"] = new[]
    {
        -25.837377992238334, -0.6852264771262435, -4.372034519324568,
    },
};

var passiveBinoParams = new Dictionary<string, object?>
{
    ["DepthSrc1"] = cameraParams,
    ["DepthSrc2"] = cameraParams,
    ["TextureSrc"] = cameraParams,
};

Interface detailed explanation

LoadGraphAsync(…​)

// original JsonElement version
Task<JsonElement> LoadGraphAsync(
    string graphName,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Generic version
Task<T> LoadGraphAsync<T>(
    string graphName,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<RuntimeGraphReference> LoadGraphInfoAsync(
    string graphName,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Load the specified graph into the Runtime inference environment (convert from editor graph to executable state).

Parameters

Name type Description

graphName

string

The name of the image to be loaded

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, key fields:

field type Description

graphId

string

Figure unique ID

graphName

string

Picture name

example

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

// Load image to Runtime
var graphRef = await client.Runtime.LoadGraphInfoAsync("detection_graph");
Console.WriteLine($"Figure has been loaded into Runtime,ID: {graphRef.GraphId}");
Console.WriteLine($"Request status: {graphRef.Status}");

RunGraphAsync(…​)

// original JsonElement version
Task<JsonElement> RunGraphAsync(
    RuntimeRunParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Generic version
Task<T> RunGraphAsync<T>(
    RuntimeRunParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<RuntimeRunGraphResult> RunGraphResultAsync(
    RuntimeRunParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Submit input data to the graph and trigger inference. This is the core interface in Runtime mode. Normal mode submits image + point cloud + camera parameters, and passive binocular mode submits complete EPICRAW3. Data is transferred efficiently in a binary protocol (application/octet-stream).

Note: When using runtime.run_graph, the current version requires that there are EpicPro输入 or EpicPro输入(单组数据) nodes and EpicPro输出 nodes in the graph. Otherwise, it cannot run and an error will be reported.

Parameters

Name type Description

paramsData.GraphName

string

Picture name

paramsData.Frames

IReadOnlyList<RuntimeFrame>

Normal mode input; each frame contains image, point cloud and camera parameters

paramsData.RunMode

string

Normal mode is "others"; Passive binocular mode is "passive_bino"

paramsData.PassiveBinoFrame

RuntimePassiveBinoFrame?

Passive binocular mode input; no need to transmit in normal mode

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, used by the caller to actively cancel

Mode selection

mode Construction method Required data

Normal mode

new RuntimeRunParams(graphName, frames)

Frames contains at least one RuntimeFrame

Passive binocular mode

RuntimeRunParams.PassiveBinoFromFile/Bytes/Images(…​)

PassiveBinoFrame.EpicRaw3 and PassiveBinoFrame.Cam2Base

Normal mode RuntimeFrame field description

field type Is it required? Description

EpicRaw

byte[]

Required (cannot be empty)

Full EPICRAW raw bytes

Cam2Base

object?

Required

Camera to base coordinate system transformation, rotation vector form, [x, y, z, rx, ry, rz] with length 6 (translation + Rodrigues rotation vector); the server currently only supports this form, and does not support matrices. If the length is incorrect, ArgumentException will be thrown

Roi

object?

Optional

region of interest; cam2ROIFrame also only supports rotation vector form with length 6

If there are EPICRAW bytes/ files, use RuntimeFrame.FromBytes(…​) / FromFile(…​); if there are only original images and point clouds, use RuntimeFrame.FromData(…​) to encode locally and receive RuntimePointData, RuntimeImageData, camera intrinsic parameters/distortion (optional cameraParams extended parameters).

Passive binocular mode RuntimePassiveBinoFrame field description

field type Is it required? Description

EpicRaw3

byte[]

Required (cannot be empty)

Full EPICRAW3 raw bytes

Cam2Base

object?

Required

Camera to base coordinate system transformation, rotation vector form, [x, y, z, rx, ry, rz] with length 6 (translation + Rodrigues rotation vector); the server currently only supports this form, and does not support matrices

Roi

object?

Optional

Area of Interest

When using PassiveBinoFromImages(…​), each image is represented by RuntimePassiveBinoImage:

field type Description

Data

byte[]

Raw pixel bytes

Width / Height

int

Image width and height

MatType

int

OpenCV Mat type, such as CV_8UC1=0, CV_16UC1=2, CV_8UC3=16

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, the summary result after the inference is completed (the specific fields are determined by the graph structure).

example

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

// Already complete EPICRAW File/bytes time,direct encapsulation:
byte[] epicRawBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("/data/camera/frame_001.epicraw");

var frames = new List<RuntimeFrame>
{
    // cam2Base The server currently only supports rotation vector form:[x, y, z, rx, ry, rz](Pan + Rodrigues rotation vector)
    RuntimeFrame.FromBytes(epicRawBytes, cam2Base: new[] { 0.0, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 })
};

// Run chart(20seconds timeout)
using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20));
var result = await client.Runtime.RunGraphResultAsync(
    new RuntimeRunParams("detection_graph", frames), cts.Token);
Console.WriteLine($"Reasoning completed,Request status: {result.Status}");

// Read binding output
var detections = await client.Runtime.GetBindedOutputValueAsync(new BindingRef("detection_graph", "result"));
Console.WriteLine($"Test results: {detections}");

SetParamsInStrategyAsync(…​)

// original JsonElement version
Task<JsonElement> SetParamsInStrategyAsync(
    RuntimeStrategyParamsUpdate paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Generic version
Task<T> SetParamsInStrategyAsync<T>(
    RuntimeStrategyParamsUpdate paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Modify node parameters that support strategy parameters in the Runtime stage according to the strategy (used with GetNodeParamsInfoWithStrategyAsync).

Support scope: Currently only supports PoseListFilter, PickPointFilter, PoseListSorterInXOY、PickPointSorterInXOY、PickPointSorterNew、 PoseListSorter These 6 types of nodes. For other nodes, please use the common parameter interface to set parameters. RuntimeStrategyParamsUpdate.ParamsData usually comes from GetNodeParamsInfoWithStrategyAsync(…​) returns paramsData in the value. Don’t just handwrite a short paragraph Local parameters; it is recommended to retain the complete structure returned by the server and only replace the fields that need to be modified.

Parameters

Name type Description

paramsData.GraphName

string

Picture name

paramsData.NodeId

string

Node ID

paramsData.ParamsData

object

The complete parameter structure modified from paramsData returned from the server

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, operation status information.

example

using System;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

var strategyInfo = await client.Runtime.GetNodeParamsInfoWithStrategyAsync(
    new NodeRef("detection_graph", "detect-node-001"));
var paramsData = JsonNode.Parse(
    strategyInfo.GetProperty("paramsData").GetRawText())!.AsObject();

paramsData["run_params"]!.AsObject()["strategies_config"] = new JsonObject
{
    ["value"] = new JsonArray
    {
        new JsonObject
        {
            ["BY_SCORE"] = new JsonObject
            {
                ["order"] = "HIGHEST",
                ["differenceThreshold"] = 1,
                ["groupInterval"] = 0.75,
            },
        },
    },
};

await client.Runtime.SetParamsInStrategyAsync(
    new RuntimeStrategyParamsUpdate(
        "detection_graph",
        "detect-node-001",
        paramsData));

Console.WriteLine("Strategy parameters updated");

GetFileParamMd5Async(…​)

// original JsonElement version
Task<JsonElement> GetFileParamMd5Async(
    FileParamRef paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Generic version
Task<T> GetFileParamMd5Async<T>(
    FileParamRef paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Strongly typed convenience version
Task<RuntimeFileParamMd5Info> GetFileParamMd5InfoAsync(
    FileParamRef paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Get the MD5 check value of a file parameter (such as a model file) in the picture, which is used to determine whether the file already exists and needs to be updated before uploading.

Parameters

Name type Description

paramsData.GraphName

string

Picture name

paramsData.ParamName

string

File parameter mapping name

paramsData.ParamType

string

parameter type, default is "init_params"

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<JsonElement>, containing md5 fields.

example

using System;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

// Get the server file MD5
var md5Info = await client.Runtime.GetFileParamMd5InfoAsync(
    new FileParamRef("detection_graph", "model_file"));
string serverMd5 = md5Info.Md5;
Console.WriteLine($"MD5 Request status: {md5Info.Status}");

// Calculate local files MD5
byte[] localBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("/models/detector.onnx");
string localMd5 = Convert.ToHexString(MD5.HashData(localBytes)).ToLowerInvariant();

if (serverMd5 == localMd5)
{
    Console.WriteLine("The model file is consistent with the server,No update required");
}
else
{
    Console.WriteLine("Model file has changed,Need to re-upload");
}

RunSingleNodeNoGraphParsedAsync(…​) (recommended)

Task<SingleNodeParsedResult> RunSingleNodeNoGraphParsedAsync(
    SingleNodeParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Does not rely on graph structure, directly runs a single node, and automatically parses the point clouds and images in outputs into directly usable data structures. Ordinary users are recommended to use this interface first; the returned dictionary key will be consistent with the server outputs key, but the point cloud and image values ​​will be parsed.

Parameters

Name type Description

paramsData.NodeName

string

Node type name

paramsData.Inputs

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>

input port data dictionary; FileInfo/byte[] will be automatically processed according to the node port type

paramsData.RunParams

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>

Run parameter dictionary

paramsData.InitParams

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>

Initialize parameter dictionary

paramsData.InputDataTypes

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>

Optional. Input port type mapping; usually omitted, SDK will automatically query when needed

paramsData.InputPointDims

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int>

Optional. Point cloud input dimension hints; often automatically inferred from port type

paramsData.OutputDataTypes

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>

Optional. Output port type mapping; when omitted, SDK will query the node output definition by node name

paramsData.OutputPointDims

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int>

Optional. Output point cloud dimension prompt; XYZPoints defaults to 3, NormalPoints/RGBPoints defaults to 6

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<SingleNodeParsedResult>:

public sealed class SingleNodeParsedResult
{
    public JsonElement? RawJsonData { get; init; }
    public byte[]? RawBinaryData { get; init; }
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> Outputs { get; init; }
}

Parsing rules:

Output port type Type of Outputs[name]

Points / XYZPoints / NormalPoints / RGBPoints

IReadOnlyList<ParsedPointCloud>

Image / MonoImage / ColorImage / BinaryImage

IReadOnlyList<ParsedImage>

Other types

JsonElement, keep the original JSON value on the server

Failure handling: If the top level of the server is status=0, but the single node result is status_queue Contains success:false, activate failed, error or negative status, SDK will be parsed Throws AtomApiException before Outputs. Exceptionally Payload retains the original result intact, status_queue, outputs, and status can still be viewed there.

example

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Models;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

var result = await client.Runtime.RunSingleNodeNoGraphParsedAsync(
    new SingleNodeParams(
        "EstimateNormal",
        inputs: new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["points"] = new FileInfo("/data/input.ply"),
        },
        outputDataTypes: new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["points"] = "XYZPoints",
        },
        outputPointDims: new Dictionary<string, int>
        {
            ["points"] = 3,
        }));

var clouds = (IReadOnlyList<ParsedPointCloud>)result.Outputs["points"]!;
Console.WriteLine($"Number of point clouds: {clouds.Count}");
Console.WriteLine($"The first point cloud shape: {string.Join(" x ", clouds[0].Shape)}");

If SDK can query the node output definition through NodeName, you don’t need to fill in OutputDataTypes; if the server returns raw bytes, or you want to save one node information query, it is recommended to fill it in explicitly. raw bytes In order for the results to be automatically parsed, the only point cloud output port must be determined.

RunSingleNodeNoGraphAsync(…​) (optional: raw return)

// Return SingleNodeResult(contains JSON or binary)
Task<SingleNodeResult> RunSingleNodeNoGraphAsync(
    SingleNodeParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

// Return the specified type(JSON output)
Task<T> RunSingleNodeNoGraphJsonAsync<T>(
    SingleNodeParams paramsData,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Purpose: Without relying on the graph structure, directly run a single node and obtain the original results of the server. Only use it when you need to handle JSON/raw bytes yourself; in normal scenarios, it is recommended to use RunSingleNodeNoGraphParsedAsync first. Like the parsed interface, if status_queue indicates that the internal operation of the node fails, the raw interface will also throw AtomApiException, and place the complete raw result in the exception’s Payload.

Parameters

Name type Description

paramsData.NodeName

string

Node type name

paramsData.Inputs

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>

input port data dictionary; FileInfo/byte[] will be automatically processed according to the node port type

paramsData.RunParams

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>

Run parameter dictionary

paramsData.InitParams

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>

Initialize parameter dictionary

paramsData.InputDataTypes

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>

Optional. Input port type mapping; usually omitted, SDK will automatically query

paramsData.InputPointDims

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int>

Optional. Point cloud input dimension hints; often automatically inferred from input type

cancellationToken

CancellationToken

Cancellation token, optional

Return value: Task<SingleNodeResult>, the JSON result can be read through .JsonData / .DeserializeJson<T>(), or the binary result can be obtained through .BinaryData. Common inputs are automatically processed by port type:

Port type C# Input value SDK behavior

File

FileInfo / UTF-8 byte[] / string

is put into JSON as a path string, and the file content is not read.

Image / MonoImage / ColorImage / BinaryImage

FileInfo / byte[] / base64 string

is converted into data:image/…​;base64,…​ string list

Points / XYZPoints / NormalPoints / RGBPoints

.ply of FileInfo / encoded byte[] / array of numbers

.ply will be converted to Atom point cloud binary; the encoded bytes will be uploaded unchanged

Other types

any JSON value / byte[] / FileInfo

maintains old behavior: JSON into inputs, bytes or file contents are uploaded by file fields

C# SDK currently supports vertex attribute reading of ASCII PLY in single-node direct operation; XYZPoints/Points reads x,y,z, NormalPoints reads x,y,z,nx,ny,nz, RGBPoints reads x,y,z,red,green,blue.

example

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;

var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");

// Example 1:incoming byte[].If the port is ColorImage,SDK will be converted into base64 Picture list;
// If the port is XYZPoints,SDK You will think that this is already encoded Atom point cloud binary.
byte[] imageBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("/data/test.jpg");
var result1 = await client.Runtime.RunSingleNodeNoGraphAsync(
    new SingleNodeParams(
        "ResizeImage",
        new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["image"] = imageBytes
        },
        new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["scale_factor"] = 0.5
        }));

// Deserialization JSON result
// var typed = result1.DeserializeJson<MyOutputType>();
Console.WriteLine($"Single node operation completed");

// Example 2:Use FileInfo Pass in local file.SDK Will be judged by port type:
// File The port only transmits the path string,ColorImage port transfer base64,XYZPoints of .ply Path to point cloud payload.
var result2 = await client.Runtime.RunSingleNodeNoGraphAsync(
    new SingleNodeParams(
        "ModelInferenceNode",
        new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["input_image"] = new FileInfo("/data/test.jpg"),
        },
        initParams: new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["model_path"] = "/models/detector.onnx"
        }));
Console.WriteLine("File input single node operation completed");

// Example 3:The generic version deserializes the result directly
// var typedResult = await client.Runtime.RunSingleNodeNoGraphJsonAsync<MyResult>(
//     new SingleNodeParams("ResizeImage", inputs: ..., runParams: ...));

Complete reasoning process example

The following example shows the complete Runtime workflow from graph loading to inference result reading:

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AtomSdk;
using AtomSdk.Core;
using AtomSdk.Models;

class RuntimeWorkflowExample
{
    static async Task Main()
    {
        var client = new AtomClient("http://localhost:8080");
        const string graphName = "detection_graph";

        try
        {
            // 1. Load image to Runtime
            var graphRef = await client.Runtime.LoadGraphInfoAsync(graphName);
            Console.WriteLine($"[1] Image loaded,ID: {graphRef.GraphId}, Request status: {graphRef.Status}");

            // 2. Get primitive information(Confirm configuration)
            var meta = await client.Runtime.GetMetaInfoModelAsync(graphName);
            Console.WriteLine($"[2] Graph element information obtained successfully,Request status: {meta.Status}");

            // 3. Set shared parameters
            await client.Runtime.SetSharedParamsAsync(
                new RuntimeParamsUpdate(graphName, new
                {
                    confidence_threshold = 0.5,
                    nms_threshold = 0.45,
                }));
            Console.WriteLine("[3] Shared parameters have been set");

            // 4. Check file parameters MD5(Avoid uploading models repeatedly)
            var md5Info = await client.Runtime.GetFileParamMd5InfoAsync(
                new FileParamRef(graphName, "model_file"));
            Console.WriteLine($"[4] Server model MD5: {md5Info.Md5}, Request status: {md5Info.Status}");

            // 5. Prepare frame data:Already complete EPICRAW Encapsulate the file directly
            byte[] epicRawBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("/data/frame.epicraw");

            var frames = new List<RuntimeFrame>
            {
                // cam2Base The server currently only supports rotation vector form:[x, y, z, rx, ry, rz](Pan + Rodrigues rotation vector)
                RuntimeFrame.FromBytes(epicRawBytes, cam2Base: new[] { 0.0, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 })
            };

            // 6. Run chart,The caller waits at most 30 Cancel automatically after seconds
            using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
            var runResult = await client.Runtime.RunGraphResultAsync(
                new RuntimeRunParams(graphName, frames), cts.Token);
            Console.WriteLine($"[6] Reasoning completed,Request status: {runResult.Status}");

            // 7. read JSON output(by binding name)
            var jsonOutput = await client.Runtime.GetBindedOutputValueAsync(
                new BindingRef(graphName, "result"));
            Console.WriteLine($"[7] Test results: {jsonOutput}");

            // 8. Read point cloud output(If any)
            // var pointClouds = await client.Runtime.GetBindedPointCloudParsedAsync(
            //     new PointCloudRef(graphName, "pointcloud_result", pointDim: 3));

            // 9. Get information about all binding outputs
            var outputsInfo = await client.Runtime.GetBindedOutputsInfoModelAsync(graphName);
            Console.WriteLine($"[9] Number of output ports: {outputsInfo.Outputs?.Length ?? 0}");

            // 10. release Runtime Graphic resources
            await client.Runtime.ReleaseGraphAsync(graphName);
            Console.WriteLine("[10] Runtime Image has been released");
        }
        catch (AtomApiException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Server error {ex.Status}: {ex.Message}");
        }
        catch (AtomHttpException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"HTTP Error {ex.StatusCode}: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}

Exception description

Exception type trigger condition

AtomApiException

The server returns a business error (the picture is not loaded, the parameters are illegal)

AtomHttpException

HTTP layer error (connection failed, timeout, 4xx/5xx status code)

AtomProtocolException

Response format parsing failed

ArgumentException Thrown when

RuntimeFrame.Image or PointCloud is an empty byte array
